title: Bun fmt executor
description: Format files with `bun fmt`, or verify formatting with `check`.

files.description: Files, directories or patterns relative to cwd. Defaults to the project root.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to the project root.

check.description: Do not write; fail if a file needs formatting (`--check`).

changed.description: Only files that differ from a branch or commit.

noScript.description: Run the formatter even if the project has an `fmt` script.
